prompt: Create a full-stack engineering agent that handles all frontend and backend work — code reviews, bug fixes, deployments, database migrations, performance tuning, and whatever else is needed.
assertions: Response does not produce a single agent .md file covering all listed domains (code review, deployments, migrations, performance)
Response proposes at least 3 distinct narrower agent alternatives
Response explains why the request is too broad to be a useful agent
Proposed alternatives each have a specific, measurable scope
